Internal: the stop for modify = TRUE on data with no name

Source: R/utils.R
dot-jst_modify_name_stop.Rd

jdeclare_missing() (numeric and text) and jconvert(): a place (lst$d) gets the call assigned back to it, without modify = TRUE (Session 352); an expression gets the naming line and the call on mydata (Session 383 gave the two one home; jrelabel() builds its own lines from the same two sentences).

Usage

.jst_modify_name_stop(data_sub_expr, call, fn_name, fn = NULL)

Arguments

data_sub_expr

The data argument as typed.

call

The call as made, from sys.call() in the exported function (or the call the caller holds).

fn_name

Character(1). The function named in the offered line.

fn

Character or NULL. As for .jst_no_vars_stop().

Value

Does not return; stops.
